newsitem.title: JAPAN: Ushio Inc shares rise in afternoon trade.
newsitem.headline: Ushio Inc shares rise in afternoon trade.

text.p: Shares in Ushio Inc rose in the Tuesday afternoon trading session as the volatility of the share's price attracted investor attention, brokers said.
As of 0452 GMT, shares in the lamp maker were up 50 yen at 1,340 yen.
"The stock market is deadlocked and investors like the fact that the shares seem to be ignoring this trend," said a broker at a middle-sized brokerage.

"The number of shares available for margin trading as well as the fact that its earnings are expected to be firm makes it easy for dealers to trade the shares," a broker at a "Big Four" brokerage said.
